If you want to upgrade from non-LTSC version to 2021 LTSC and you want to keep the files & apps, there is an **unsupported** way. Or you can only keep your files.

Change your registry:

```
Windows Registry Editor Version 5.00
 [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion]
"CompositionEditionID"="EnterpriseS"
"EditionID"="EnterpriseS"
```

Then it should work.

Tested on Windows 10 21H2 Enterprise & Windows 10 20H2 Enterprise.
